decoder_confound_control.interpretation: Three additional CLIP-encoder MLLMs with non-LLaVA decoders (BLIP-2 OPT-2.7B rho=0.393; InstructBLIP-Flan-T5-XL rho=0.243; IDEFICS-9B rho=0.168) all fall at or below the LLaVA CLIP-group range (0.402-0.521), spanning three decoder families (OPT, FLAN-T5, LLaMA-1) and two fusion paradigms (Q-Former, perceiver), indicating the low CLIP-group rho is not driven by LLaVA-family decoders. Caveat: all three exhibit class-prior response biases (near-deterministic single-attractor outputs within each sub-dataset), limiting the information content of their per-class accuracies.

note: New models evaluated with llava_scb5.py protocol (class-name prompt, 100/class, seed 42), identical to existing LLaVA-1.5-7B. BLIP-2 reported as decoder-confound control, not merged into CLIP group.
